rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun in accusative singular, object of jñātvā
absolutive (gerund) from root jñā with suffix -tvā
compound of gūḍha and sadbhāva in accusative singular masculine
abstract noun in nominative singular neuter, subject of prajāyate
pra + jāyate, third singular present ātmanepada from root jan

items.question: What arises when the hidden true nature of that is known?
premises: knowing that hidden true nature precedes arising
the verse gives a causal sequence
items.inference: Knowledge of the hidden true nature gives rise to all-knowingness.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
